posts.excerpt: Suita, hon-suita, tenjō-suita, tomae, uchigumori, renge, karasu — the layer names of Kyoto finishing stones, what they tend to mean for hardness, and how to read the nests (su) that give suita its name.
posts.title: What Is Suita? How to Read the "Layers" of a Japanese Natural Whetstone
